turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure. Regular past simple verbs take -ed, but watch the spelling: stop → stopped (double the consonant), study → studied (y becomes ied), like → liked (just add -d). Notice the pronunciation too: /t/ in watched, /d/ in played, /ɪd/ in visited.

Exercise: Write the past simple of each verb:
Last weekend we ___ (plan) a trip and ___ (try) a new restaurant.
